release.content: pubkit 0.12.0 was released on 2026-10-20 from commit 631de5fe0346e516cf467e22f8a7e241ae0a9ecf with these changes.

rows: pubkit protect prints the reasons GitHub gives for rejecting a ruleset, such as a required check's app not being installed on the repository, and says a repository admin must run it only when GitHub refuses access (HTTP 403 or 404)

pubkit protect no longer ships a list of repositories: it reads protected.json in the working directory, or --config FILE, or protects the repositories named with --require CHECK (repeated) and no list. pubkit's own list is protected.json at its root. pubkit new prints the pubkit protect --require line for the new package

release.scope: the published release v0.12.0 of pubkit
